title: Rodent & Roach: where we're up to (JONRA)
caption:
Client story: Rodent & Roach Pest Control.

A great pest control business, ready for the next level. We built the new website from scratch, sourced, set up and tested 20+ cameras for Pest Watch, and handled the tech so he can keep doing what he does best.

Still to finish: the new logo is with the designers, and the website goes live in December.

Hands on. Getting stuck in. That's how we work with every business.
